authors: Le Ren, Veenu Tripathi, Johannes Kröger, Jannes Wübbena, Stefano Caizzone, Steffen Schön
name: luh-calibrations-accurauto
notes:
This zip package contains multi-GNSS vehicle antenna calibration results generated within the __ACCURAUTO__ project (Accurate prediction of GNSS antenna performance in automotive scenarios). All results are provided in the ANTEX (Antenna Exchange) format and include:

-   Phase center offsets and variations (PCO/PCV) per frequency block (entries under _START OF FREQUENCY_)
-  Group delay variations for code measurements (GDV, also referred to as code‑phase center corrections, CPC; entries under _START OF GDV_)


The archive is organized into two top-level folders with results from DLR and Geopp:

-  DLR: ANTEX files for multiple vehicle orientations relative to the calibration setup, including runs that incorporate the vehicle CAD model, as well as standalone antenna calibrations.
-  Geopp: calibration results for the standalone antenna (folder "Roboter") and for the antenna mounted on the vehicle (folder "Insitu").


Further details on __ACCURAUTO__ are available in:

-  Kröger, J., Ren, L., Wübbena, J., Tripathi, V., Caizzone, S., and Schön, S. (2024). _Impact of GNSS receivers on GNSS antenna performance prediction for automotive scenarios_. In: 11th ESA Workshop on Satellite Navigation Technologies and European Workshop on GNSS Signals and Signal Processing (NAVITEC), Noordwijk, The Netherlands. Presentation
-  Tripathi, Veenu and Caizzone, Stefano (2025). _Hybrid GNSS Antenna Characterization for Automotive Scenarios_. European Conference on Antennas and Propagation (EuCAP) 2025, 2025-03-30 - 2025-04-04, Stockholm, Sweden
title: ACCURAUTO: GNSS Vehicle Antenna Calibration Results
